description: This file implements a WKURLSchemeHandler for serving files from a specified root directory, handling URL requests, resolving file paths, and serving HTML error or scaffold pages within a macOS application context.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A final class implementing WKURLSchemeHandler to handle custom URL scheme requests by serving local files within a specified root directory, including logic for resolving paths, handling errors, and providing fallback pages.

methods.name: webView(_: start:)
methods.description: Handles the start of a URL scheme task, resolving the URL, preparing the response data or error response, and marking the request as complete.

methods.name: webView(_: stop:)
methods.description: A no-op method called to stop the scheme task.

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a CanvasResponse object by processing the incoming URL, verifying scheme and session, resolving file paths, and reading file data, with error handling for various invalid or malicious inputs.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:, requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves a user request path to a file URL within the session root directory, falling back to index files and handling directory traversal attempts.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Attempts to resolve 'index.html' or 'index.htm' within a directory.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Checks if a file URL is within a specific directory, preventing directory escapes.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Creates a CanvasResponse containing a simple HTML error or message page.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Generates a welcome page indicating Canvas is ready and instructing the user to create an index.html.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Returns a default scaffold page, either from bundled resources or a fallback welcome page.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data bundled within the app given a resource path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Determines the text encoding name for a given MIME type.
